afterBurst.label: After her Burst
afterBurst.reason: The crit bonus lasts 8 seconds after her Burst, which covers the Burst but only part of her Normal Attacks and Skill.

afterReact.label: Constellation 4 after a reaction
afterReact.reason: A Constellation 4 ATK bonus after an Electro reaction, which depends on the team's elements.

c6Stack.label: Constellation 6, three stacks
c6Stack.reason: With Constellation 6 her own Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Skill and Burst each start an 8-second Electro bonus, so three stacks are up through her usual string.

afterRecast.label: Electro infusion after her Skill
afterRecast.reason: Recasting Stellar Restoration gives her weapon an Electro infusion for 5 seconds, which she renews with her Skill and throws her Normal and Charged Attacks inside; charging into the stiletto instead of recasting gives no infusion.
